translations.app.name: Palworld
translations.app.subtitle: Server Manager
translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.settings.subtitle: Desktop behavior and manager-owned storage.
translations.settings.tray.title: Close to system tray
translations.settings.tray.description: Keep the manager and supervised servers operating when the window is closed. Quit fully from the tray menu.
translations.settings.tray.enabledNotice: Closing the window will keep the manager in the tray.
translations.settings.tray.disabledNotice: Closing the window will exit the manager.
translations.settings.launch.title: Launch at login
translations.settings.launch.description: Start the manager after signing in so worlds with autostart enabled can recover without manually opening the application.
translations.settings.launch.hiddenHelp: Adds --hidden only to the login launch.
translations.settings.launch.gpuHelp: Adds --disable-gpu as a renderer compatibility fallback.
translations.settings.launch.x11Help: Adds --ozone-platform=x11 for remote-desktop or Wayland issues.
translations.settings.launch.flagsHelp: Advanced Electron/Chromium flags, separated by spaces. Quotes are supported. Manager-controlled and remote-debugging flags are rejected.
translations.settings.launch.compatibilityHelp: Linux AppImage shared-memory and sandbox compatibility flags remain automatic. These options affect login launches only; manual launches are unchanged.
translations.settings.launch.enabledHiddenNotice: The manager will start hidden in the tray at login.
translations.settings.launch.enabledWindowNotice: The manager will start with its window open at login.
translations.settings.launch.savedEnabledNotice: Login launch options saved and the autostart entry was updated.
translations.settings.launch.savedDisabledNotice: Login launch options saved. They will be used if launch at login is enabled.
translations.settings.port.title: Manager web port
translations.settings.port.description: The desktop interface and authenticated remote screen share this port. Changing it requires a manager restart.
translations.settings.port.label: Port
translations.settings.port.savedRestart: Manager port {{port}} saved. Restart the manager to apply it.
translations.settings.retention.title: History and log retention
translations.settings.retention.description: Keep useful operational records without allowing the manager database and per-launch server logs to grow forever. The age and count limits are both enforced; whichever is reached first applies. Running operations are never removed.
translations.settings.retention.help: Saving applies cleanup immediately. Future cleanup runs automatically every six hours.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired record or log file.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice_other: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired records or log files.
translations.settings.retention.emptyNotice: Retention policy saved. Nothing currently needs cleanup.
translations.settings.data.title: Manager data
translations.settings.data.description: The rewrite keeps its database, SteamCMD, logs, and backups separate from the legacy manager.
translations.settings.language.title: Language
translations.settings.language.description: English is built in. Additional validated PSM Next language packs can be installed without replacing application files.
translations.settings.language.label: Display language
translations.settings.language.fileHelp: Language packs are JSON files. Missing strings fall back to English.
translations.settings.language.removedNotice: Language pack removed; English fallback remains available.
translations.settings.language.invalidSize: Language packs must be smaller than 512 KiB.
translations.build.current: Installed build {{installed}} matches the latest public build.
translations.build.updateAvailable: Update required: installed build {{installed}}; latest public build {{latest}}.
translations.build.installedUnknown: The installed build could not be detected.
translations.build.latestUnknown: Installed build {{installed}}; the latest public build has not been checked.
translations.jobs.dialog.noOutputHelp: This operation reports its result through the status above.
translations.operations.title: Operation history
translations.operations.subtitle: Progress, results, and command output for server management tasks.
translations.dashboard.title: Palworld servers
translations.dashboard.importDescription: Review the imported path and ports. Credentials are never stored in registration exports.
translations.dashboard.addDescription: Install a fresh dedicated server or register one already on disk.
translations.dashboard.installModeHelp: Download a separate Palworld server with SteamCMD.
translations.dashboard.adoptModeHelp: Register a folder containing PalServer without downloading it again.
translations.dashboard.name: Name
translations.dashboard.emptyHelp: Add an existing Palworld install or provision a new one.
translations.dashboard.registrationLoaded: Registration loaded. Review the installation path and ports before adding it.
translations.dashboard.registrationTooLarge: Registration files must be smaller than 1 MiB.
translations.dashboard.installStartFailed: World registered, but installation could not be started: {{error}}
translations.dashboard.noEligible: No worlds are currently eligible to {{action}}.
translations.structured.saved_one: Saved {{count}} setting; restart to apply changes
translations.structured.saved_other: Saved {{count}} settings; restart to apply changes
translations.structured.archiveTooLarge: Configuration archives must be smaller than 5 MB.
translations.structured.imported: Configuration imported; restart to apply changes.
translations.structured.restartRequired: Restart required — configuration was saved after this server started.
translations.structured.changedOnly: Only changed fields are written. Unknown advanced INI options remain untouched.
translations.backups.title: Backups
translations.backups.description: Verified snapshots of this world's Saved directory.
translations.backups.destinationHelp: Leave blank to use isolated manager storage. Game installation paths are rejected.
translations.backups.retentionHelp: 0 keeps all backups. Retention runs only after a new archive verifies.
translations.backups.stopToRestore: Stop the server before restoring a backup.
translations.monitor.title: {{world}} operations
translations.monitor.description: Live server health, console output, and persistent operational history.
translations.monitor.noLogOutput: No log output has been recorded for this world.
translations.schedules.title: Automated operations
translations.schedules.description: Schedules run in the persistent manager runtime. Daily times use this computer's local timezone.
translations.schedules.noticeHelp: Uses REST chat fallback until the broadcast mod is available.
translations.schedules.messageHelp: Sent through Palworld REST as a System announcement.
translations.warnings.title: Warn players before maintenance
translations.warnings.description: For scheduled restart, stop, and update jobs, announce a countdown before Palworld's native final shutdown timer.
translations.warnings.defaultMessage: The server will {action} in {minutes} minute(s). Please get to a safe place.
translations.serverSetup.title: Runtime and access
translations.serverSetup.description: Listening ports, credentials, manager automation, and process-launch settings. INI-backed values are synchronized when this section is saved.
translations.managerProperties.title: PSM properties
translations.managerProperties.description: The local name, installation location, and runtime platform PSM uses to identify and find this server. Palworld gameplay settings are under Server config.
translations.managerProperties.locationHelp: The path and platform are shown here because they belong to this PSM registration, not PalWorldSettings.ini.
translations.managerProperties.stopToRelocate: Stop this server before changing its installation path or platform. Its current values are shown read-only while running.
translations.properties.security: Registration exports include the installation path, platform, startup, launch, and environment settings. Passwords are excluded; environment variables may contain sensitive values.
translations.properties.name: Name
translations.properties.stopToEdit: Stop this server before changing ports, environment, or process-launch settings.
translations.properties.environmentInvalid: Environment must be a JSON object whose values are strings.
translations.properties.savedSynchronized: World settings saved and synchronized to PalWorldSettings.ini
translations.properties.unregisterConfirm: Unregister {{world}}? Server files will not be deleted.
translations.world.config.saved: Configuration saved; restart to apply changes
translations.world.config.restored: Configuration version restored; restart to apply changes
translations.world.backupRestoreConfirm: Restore this verified backup? A safety backup will be created first.
translations.players.title: Players
translations.players.offlineHelp: Start the server with its REST API enabled to view and moderate players.
translations.players.idHelp: Kick and ban use the player's REST user ID, not their display name.
translations.players.moderateHelp: Use this to unban an offline player or act on a known user ID.
translations.deaths.title: Death history
translations.deaths.description: Preserved records from the legacy manager, newest first.
translations.deaths.emptyHelp: Live death capture requires the deferred PSM Death Relay extension. Existing imported history will appear here.
translations.console.title: Live server log
translations.console.adminDescription: Uses Palworld's local REST API. Actions are recorded in world history.
translations.console.restDisabled: Enable REST API in World Properties and restart the server to use these controls.
translations.console.rconDescription: Deprecated by Pocketpair. Prefer the REST controls above; this console is available only because RCON is explicitly enabled for this world.
translations.console.noResponse: Command completed without a text response.
translations.remote.login.title: Remote access
translations.remote.login.description: Enter the six-digit code provided by the server administrator.
translations.remote.title: Palworld worlds
translations.remoteSettings.title: Authenticated remote administration
translations.remoteSettings.description: Allow scoped access from another device. Existing manager pages remain desktop-only; remote users receive a restricted control screen.
translations.remoteSettings.desktopOnly: LAN binding is available only in the desktop application.
translations.remoteSettings.savedRestart: {{state}}. Restart the manager to apply the network binding.
translations.remoteSettings.disabledNotice: Remote access is disabled and all sessions were revoked.
translations.remoteSettings.restartRequired: Restart required: the manager is currently listening on {{target}}.
translations.remoteSettings.created: Access code created. Copy it now; it cannot be shown again.
translations.remoteSettings.codeDisabled: Access code disabled and its sessions revoked.
translations.remoteSettings.noCodes: No remote access codes have been created.
